pitchEmail.subject: Community Partnership Opportunity: Atlanta Hawks Fans Blood Drive
pitchEmail.body: Dear Atlanta Hawks community team, I am reaching out from the local blood centre. We are currently running a community blood drive in Atlanta that ends on December 13. We are looking to engage local fan bases to help us reach our goal of 300 donors. We would love to see if you would be willing to help us spread the word to Atlanta Hawks fans about the importance of blood donation. We are not asking for any official endorsement or team involvement, simply a share to your community to help us boost turnout for this health initiative. If you are interested in helping us promote this life-saving cause, I would be happy to provide shareable graphics or more information. Thank you for your time and for all you do for the city of Atlanta.
